thread:
elena: Heads-up — we need a short migration note and SDK snippet updates for the upcoming model name swap (old open-llama-v1 -> open-llama-2-compat). Infra will flip the alias and the old exact id will start returning 412 for requests that reference it directly. Draft docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123 Staging preview available. Who can take TS/Py snippets?
sam: I can take TypeScript snippets. Can someone paste an example of the old v1 snippet so I can make a minimal diff?
jordan: I'll do Python. Is there also a change to the responses vs models endpoint we should call out, or is this strictly model id swap?
elena: Strictly id swap for this wave — no endpoint signature changes. We still need to call out families vs pinned ids though. If you've pinned an exact id you'll need to update it. If you used the family alias (e.g., open-llama), you should be fine.
maria: I'll add a small migration guide section and a changelog entry. Also will add a "what to expect during flip" callout.
alex: FYI infra plans the flip Tue 03:00 UTC. Docs need to be live and merged before then — prefer by Tue 01:00 UTC.
sarah: Quick question: what's the final canonical id? Is it open-llama-2-compat or open-llama-v2-compat? I've seen both in different places.
elena: Canonical id is open-llama-2-compat. Sorry for the confusion — update examples to that.
sam: Ok here's the minimal TS diff I'll land in examples: 
Old (v1):
```
const out = await client.models.predict({
  model: "open-llama-v1",
  prompt: "Summarize..."
})
```
New (swap):
```
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: "open-llama-2-compat",
  input: "Summarize..."
})
```
I'll open a PR to replace the snippet in examples and add a short callout about pinned ids.
jordan: Python equivalents I'll push: 
Old:
```
resp = client.models.predict("open-llama-v1", prompt="Translate...")
```
New:
```
resp = client.responses.create(model="open-llama-2-compat", input="Translate...")
```
I'll also add a tiny test snippet showing how to verify the model id returned metadata.
maria: I've drafted the migration note: "If you pinned an exact model id, update to the new id; if you used a family alias, no change required." Also adding a troubleshooting section for 412 responses.
alex: Please include an ops note recommending exponential backoff for 429s — some customers experience a short surge during flips.
sam: PR created for TS snippets: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4124 — replaces two examples and adds a short callout. Preview link in CI.
docs-bot: Preview deployed — https://deploy-preview-4124--docs.redwood.ai/examples/response-snippets
jordan: PR for Python examples: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4125 — added examples and tests but CI lint failing on line length. Anyone can fix the formatter?
elena: I'll run the formatter and push fix. Also we need to update sidebar nav to include the migration note so customers can find it quickly.
maria: Changelog entry draft in PR 4126, tagging @elena. Also added a brief "how to verify" section (call sample request + check model id in response).
sarah: Can someone add a short example of handling a 412 and falling back to family alias? That will be helpful for customers who pinned bad ids.
jordan: I'll add a Python snippet for 412 handler.
sam: Added a TS 412 handler to my PR as well (simple retry + fallback to alias).
elena: Timeline recap: merge docs PRs by Tue 01:00 UTC, push live by 02:00 UTC, infra flip at 03:00 UTC. Ops will monitor for errors and roll back if needed.
alex: Acknowledged. I'll post a heads-up in #release-war-room 30m before flip.
maria: Thanks all — if anyone hits blockers ping me or @elena. :rocket:
